name = "aspis-statement"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "No-proof SpendV0 evaluator and constraint-composition kernels for Aspis"

[features]
# R-E4 measured regression: retained for audit, never selected by default.
r0-r91-audit = ["aspis-core/r0-r91-audit"]
# Frozen R-E3 differential and passive field-byte tracing; native only.
r0-e4-reference = ["aspis-core/r0-e4-reference"]
# Native differential evidence only; absent from the SBF probe.
r0-hoist-reference = ["aspis-core/r0-hoist-reference"]
r0 = ["aspis-core/r0"]
# Exposes the deliberately broken lambda^0 tagged-tuple compression solely
# for adversarial teeth/evaluation builds. The verifier program does not
# forward this feature; enabling it requires an explicit dependency feature.
insecure-test-logup-compression = []
# Derive only the public RATE512 circle/line coordinates touched by Spend
# queries. This preserves the proof and verifier equations while allowing a
# deployment build to dead-strip the six complete RATE512 lookup tables.
spend-dynamic-rate512 = []
# Host by default; the separate Pool V1 program enables this explicitly for
# SBF. Frozen verifier builds do not enable it.
pool-v1-kernel = []
# Audit-only algebraic rewrite for the pair-forest public-digest constraints.
# It packs each four-lane residual before applying its common selector; the
# default and released terminal retain the literal lane-by-lane evaluator.
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-audit = []
# Audit-only selector-tensor continuation of packed digest binding. Each
# binding keeps its two packed residuals, while `high[block] * low[local]` is
# contracted as three exact local-coordinate sums.
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-selector-tensor-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-audit",
]
# Audit-only exact `{0,1}` specialization for generated pair-forest Copy
# weights. The literal QM31-by-M31 multiplication remains the default.
pool-v1-pair-forest-binary-copy-weights-audit = []
# Audit-only memoization of generated Copy endpoint row selectors. The cache
# never supplies a value unless its stored row tag matches exactly.
pool-v1-pair-forest-endpoint-selector-cache-audit = []
# Audit-only exact common-factor extraction in the selected semantic lanes.
# It preserves all 94 source residuals and their 24 packed theta lanes.
pool-v1-pair-forest-semantic-factor-audit = []
# Audit-only exact CSE for the fourteen generated Copy tuple patterns.
pool-v1-pair-forest-pattern-window-audit = []
# Audit-only exact change of basis for the compiled Copy values.  Endpoint
# selectors are accumulated by their fixed tuple-pattern coordinate before
# the dynamic pattern values are multiplied, replacing 272 repeated QM31
# products by the 26 nonzero coordinates of the frozen four-by-fourteen
# support matrix.  Tags remain included through exact M31 multiplication.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-pattern-basis-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-range-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-active-mask-basis-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-pattern-basis-audit",
]
# Audit-only lazy-reduction dot kernel for the generated Copy tags. Endpoint
# products are regrouped by the exact `(side, slot, local)` tensor coordinate
# and reduced in batches of at most four M31 products.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-tag-dot-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit",
]
# Audit-only four-product contraction of the tag/low and weight/low tensor
# coordinates after exact endpoint collection.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-finish-dot-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit",
]

[package]
name = "aspis-statement"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "No-proof SpendV0 evaluator and constraint-composition kernels for Aspis"

[features]
# R-E4 measured regression: retained for audit, never selected by default.
r0-r91-audit = ["aspis-core/r0-r91-audit"]
# Frozen R-E3 differential and passive field-byte tracing; native only.
r0-e4-reference = ["aspis-core/r0-e4-reference"]
# Native differential evidence only; absent from the SBF probe.
r0-hoist-reference = ["aspis-core/r0-hoist-reference"]
r0 = ["aspis-core/r0"]
# Exposes the deliberately broken lambda^0 tagged-tuple compression solely
# for adversarial teeth/evaluation builds. The verifier program does not
# forward this feature; enabling it requires an explicit dependency feature.
insecure-test-logup-compression = []
# Derive only the public RATE512 circle/line coordinates touched by Spend
# queries. This preserves the proof and verifier equations while allowing a
# deployment build to dead-strip the six complete RATE512 lookup tables.
spend-dynamic-rate512 = []
# Host by default; the separate Pool V1 program enables this explicitly for
# SBF. Frozen verifier builds do not enable it.
pool-v1-kernel = []
# Audit-only algebraic rewrite for the pair-forest public-digest constraints.
# It packs each four-lane residual before applying its common selector; the
# default and released terminal retain the literal lane-by-lane evaluator.
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-audit = []
# Audit-only selector-tensor continuation of packed digest binding. Each
# binding keeps its two packed residuals, while `high[block] * low[local]` is
# contracted as three exact local-coordinate sums.
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-selector-tensor-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-audit",
]
# Audit-only exact `{0,1}` specialization for generated pair-forest Copy
# weights. The literal QM31-by-M31 multiplication remains the default.
pool-v1-pair-forest-binary-copy-weights-audit = []
# Audit-only memoization of generated Copy endpoint row selectors. The cache
# never supplies a value unless its stored row tag matches exactly.
pool-v1-pair-forest-endpoint-selector-cache-audit = []
# Audit-only exact common-factor extraction in the selected semantic lanes.
# It preserves all 94 source residuals and their 24 packed theta lanes.
pool-v1-pair-forest-semantic-factor-audit = []
# Audit-only exact CSE for the fourteen generated Copy tuple patterns.
pool-v1-pair-forest-pattern-window-audit = []
# Audit-only exact change of basis for the compiled Copy values.  Endpoint
# selectors are accumulated by their fixed tuple-pattern coordinate before
# the dynamic pattern values are multiplied, replacing 272 repeated QM31
# products by the 26 nonzero coordinates of the frozen four-by-fourteen
# support matrix.  Tags remain included through exact M31 multiplication.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-pattern-basis-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-range-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-active-mask-basis-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-pattern-basis-audit",
]
# Audit-only lazy-reduction dot kernel for the generated Copy tags. Endpoint
# products are regrouped by the exact `(side, slot, local)` tensor coordinate
# and reduced in batches of at most four M31 products.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-tag-dot-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit",
]
# Audit-only four-product contraction of the tag/low and weight/low tensor
# coordinates after exact endpoint collection.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-finish-dot-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit",
]

[package]
name = "aspis-statement"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "No-proof SpendV0 evaluator and constraint-composition kernels for Aspis"

[features]
# R-E4 measured regression: retained for audit, never selected by default.
r0-r91-audit = ["aspis-core/r0-r91-audit"]
# Frozen R-E3 differential and passive field-byte tracing; native only.
r0-e4-reference = ["aspis-core/r0-e4-reference"]
# Native differential evidence only; absent from the SBF probe.
r0-hoist-reference = ["aspis-core/r0-hoist-reference"]
r0 = ["aspis-core/r0"]
# Exposes the deliberately broken lambda^0 tagged-tuple compression solely
# for adversarial teeth/evaluation builds. The verifier program does not
# forward this feature; enabling it requires an explicit dependency feature.
insecure-test-logup-compression = []
# Derive only the public RATE512 circle/line coordinates touched by Spend
# queries. This preserves the proof and verifier equations while allowing a
# deployment build to dead-strip the six complete RATE512 lookup tables.
spend-dynamic-rate512 = []
# Host by default; the separate Pool V1 program enables this explicitly for
# SBF. Frozen verifier builds do not enable it.
pool-v1-kernel = []
# Audit-only algebraic rewrite for the pair-forest public-digest constraints.
# It packs each four-lane residual before applying its common selector; the
# default and released terminal retain the literal lane-by-lane evaluator.
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-audit = []
# Audit-only selector-tensor continuation of packed digest binding. Each
# binding keeps its two packed residuals, while `high[block] * low[local]` is
# contracted as three exact local-coordinate sums.
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-selector-tensor-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-audit",
]
# Audit-only exact `{0,1}` specialization for generated pair-forest Copy
# weights. The literal QM31-by-M31 multiplication remains the default.
pool-v1-pair-forest-binary-copy-weights-audit = []
# Audit-only memoization of generated Copy endpoint row selectors. The cache
# never supplies a value unless its stored row tag matches exactly.
pool-v1-pair-forest-endpoint-selector-cache-audit = []
# Audit-only exact common-factor extraction in the selected semantic lanes.
# It preserves all 94 source residuals and their 24 packed theta lanes.
pool-v1-pair-forest-semantic-factor-audit = []
# Audit-only exact CSE for the fourteen generated Copy tuple patterns.
pool-v1-pair-forest-pattern-window-audit = []
# Audit-only exact change of basis for the compiled Copy values.  Endpoint
# selectors are accumulated by their fixed tuple-pattern coordinate before
# the dynamic pattern values are multiplied, replacing 272 repeated QM31
# products by the 26 nonzero coordinates of the frozen four-by-fourteen
# support matrix.  Tags remain included through exact M31 multiplication.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-pattern-basis-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-range-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-active-mask-basis-audit = []
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-pattern-basis-audit",
]
# Audit-only lazy-reduction dot kernel for the generated Copy tags. Endpoint
# products are regrouped by the exact `(side, slot, local)` tensor coordinate
# and reduced in batches of at most four M31 products.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-tag-dot-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit",
]
# Audit-only four-product contraction of the tag/low and weight/low tensor
# coordinates after exact endpoint collection.
pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-finish-dot-basis-audit = [
    "pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit",
]

[dependencies]
aspis-core.workspace = true

[dev-dependencies]
p3-field = "=0.6.1"
p3-mersenne-31 = "=0.6.1"
p3-symmetric = "=0.6.1"
sha2.workspace = true
